The Household Protocol

You choose who you live with. You choose who visits. You maintain the standard.

Roommate Autonomy

Unlike corporate housing, we do not use algorithms to assign strangers to your spare bedroom. You build your own household.

  • Zero Gender Restrictions

    We respect the diversity of households. Co-ed groups, siblings, couples, and families are welcome. We lease the unit to the group; we do not police the gender composition of the rooms.

  • Bed-Sharing / Occupancy

    Double occupancy of a single bedroom is permitted (subject to fire code limits), provided all leaseholders agree. Whether for medical necessity, relationship status, or cost-saving, this is your decision.

Accessibility & Caregivers

Residents requiring live-in assistance (medical or familial) face no bureaucratic hurdles here. Because you control the entire unit, your caregiver is not an "Unauthorized Guest"—they are a member of your household.

Strict Visitor Protocol

Stardust Blacksburg prioritizes academic focus and sleep hygiene. To prevent unauthorized "move-ins" and disruptions, the following rules are strictly enforced.

1. Unanimous Consent

Every roommate has Veto Power. A guest (daytime or overnight) requires the consent of 100% of the leaseholders present in the unit. If one person is studying and says "No," the guest cannot enter.

2. The Escort Mandate

Keys are for Residents Only. Guests must be escorted by their host at all times while on property. You may not give your key or fob to a guest. Unescorted non-residents will be trespassed.

Daytime Visitor Hours

10:00 AM – 11:59 PM

(Daily)

  • Why 11:59 PM? We use a precise minute to remove ambiguity. If the clock strikes 12:00 AM, the guest is considered Overnight.
  • Early Access: Visits before 10:00 AM require written approval from Management to protect sleep schedules.
Overnight Protocol

The "48/7" Rule

  • Limit: Max 2 consecutive nights.
  • Cooling Off: After 2 nights, the guest is prohibited from staying overnight for 7 full days.
  • Note: This guest MAY return as a daytime visitor during the cooling-off period, provided they depart strictly by 11:59 PM.
"We lease to you, not your significant other. Renters pay for the right to a quiet home."

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
